evidence: Matches Utils/log/libs label and modifies core logging utilities in src/util/log.h and src/logging.cpp.
rationale: Refactors logging macros to decouple logging calls from a single global logger instance and enable contextual logging for multi-instance use cases. This addresses the limitation that 'forces all potential users of the library ... to use shared global state', providing foundational leverage for kernel decoupling and downstream work like #30342.
